source.dataset: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
source.conversion: cgspeed MotionBuilder-friendly BVH; frame 0 is a T-pose
source.rights: CMU permits research and commercial use; Bruce Hahne places no additional restrictions on this BVH conversion.
source.acknowledgment: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

preparation: Root travel removed, heading aligned, endpoint residual removed with smoothstep. Rounded BVH frame time uses the documented nominal capture rate. Periodic sampling is a study adaptation, not untouched mocap.
